com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Approve or reject a request you are authorized to decide. Rejection also rejects the invoice; request approval and final invoice approval are separate steps. Later invoice approval can trigger configured accounting export. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview approving the pending request we selected, with the note: Source and supporting details reviewed. Explain which invoice-approval steps remain and any automatic-export implications, then wait for my confirmation.
Preview rejecting the selected approval request, with the note: Purchase order is missing. Show the resulting invoice-review effect and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_resolve_approval_request, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare an approved or rejected decision on an exact approval request. Requires confirmation, current named/delegated authority, amount limits and required notes.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: resolve_approval_request
title: Decide an approval request
